name: FarmDash Agent OS
description: Give DeFi agents protocol intelligence, wallet-risk analysis, simulation and zero-custody execution controls through REST and 94 MCP tools.
longDescription: FarmDash Agent OS is a zero-custody DeFi intelligence and execution-control layer for AI agents. MCP v5.0.0 exposes 94 capability-labeled tools. USER_SIGNED is the default; separately authorized policy-bounded automation is gated by live capabilities. Payment, API keys and sessions do not grant transaction authority. FarmDash never receives customer raw private keys. Public source installation uses a local stdio adapter; npm publication and remote MCP transport are not claimed. Scout access is free and quota-limited, with paid API tiers and route-specific x402 access. ERC-4337 server submission, generic server intent execution and MEE remain preparation-only; ACP depends on deployment prerequisites.

skills.name: Protocol Intelligence
skills.description: Research DeFi protocols with Trail Heat scores, risk factors and yield context before choosing an agent workflow.

skills.name: Wallet Risk Analysis
skills.description: Inspect wallet balances, portfolio context and Sybil or allowance-risk signals for agent planning.

skills.name: Simulate and Authorize
skills.description: Simulate proposed actions and apply user-signed or separately authorized policy-bounded execution controls.

authInstructions: Scout access is keyless within published route quotas. FARMDASH_API_KEY is optional for local stdio clients and enables paid capacity; it does not authorize transactions. Customers retain signing keys.
